## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] `npm ci && npm run check` in `web/`
- [ ] No credentials, runtime data, backups, or private endpoints are included
- [ ] User-visible changes include structured release notes

## Compatibility and rollback

Describe data migration, API, Agent, mobile/desktop UI, deployment, and rollback impact.
